positioning: Since 2026-11-26 (the user's rule): Rota 360 = 'Dünyanın gizemli, kutsal ve kayıp yerlerini 2D anlatan Türkçe kanal'. Mysterious places, sacred and spiritual places, ancient cities and old maps, legends of lost continents, pirates and the places they sailed, and how people crossed oceans and travelled the world. Still 2D (Inside Out flat style), 20-30 s.
how_to_use: Pick ONE topic without used_by. Rotate series: never two in a row from the same series. Score 3 candidates (PLAYBOOK section 3) and make the best; a viewer request passed on by the user goes first.

Every fact: 2 reliable sources (UNESCO, encyclopaedias like Britannica, museums, NOAA/NASA/USGS, university pages, official sites such as diyanet.gov.tr / vatican.va / ayasofyacamii.gov.tr). Cut what fails.

LEGENDS AND PSEUDOSCIENCE (ley lines, Mu, Atlantis, Bermuda, 'energy' places, Piri Reis-Antarctica): always frame as 'iddia vs kanıt' - say clearly what the legend claims and what the evidence shows. Never present a myth as fact (Meta misinformation + Recommendations Guidelines; PLAYBOOK ethics). The hook can use the mystery; the payoff must be honest.
Follow engine/META_COMPLIANCE.txt for every topic, especially the notes in each item.
After publishing set used_by=<slug> and commit this file to engine/ with the video.

series.Kutsal Mekanlar: sacred and spiritual places of all faiths, respectful
series.Kayıp Kıtalar: Mu, Atlantis, Lemurya - legend vs geology
series.Korsan Rotaları: famous pirates, corsairs and the places they sailed
series.Okyanusu Geçmek: how old ships crossed oceans; how to travel the world

topics.title_tr: Ley hatları: Dünyayı saran gizli çizgiler mi?
topics.hook: Haritada çizersen Stonehenge'den katedrallere düz bir çizgi çıkıyor… peki bu tesadüf mü?
facts_to_check: The term 'ley lines' was coined by Alfred Watkins (The Old Straight Track, 1925; 'leys' 1921).
Later New Age writers claimed 'earth energy' along them - no scientific evidence.
With enough points on a map, straight alignments appear by chance (statistical studies).
topics.compliance: iddia vs kanıt framing; no health/energy claims.

topics.title_tr: Bermuda Şeytan Üçgeni gerçekten tehlikeli mi?
topics.hook: Gemileri yuttuğu söylenen bir üçgen var… ama sigorta şirketleri ona ekstra prim istemiyor.
facts_to_check: NOAA: no evidence that disappearances occur more frequently there than in other heavily travelled ocean areas.
Lloyd's of London does not charge higher premiums for it (widely reported - verify).
Gulf Stream, storms and heavy traffic explain losses.
topics.compliance: no mocking of victims; honest payoff.

topics.hook: Dünyada her an milyonlarca insan aynı noktaya dönüyor.
facts_to_check: Kiswah (örtü) is renewed every year (verify process/date).
Dimensions of the Kaaba (~13 m high - verify with 2 sources).
Muslims around the world face it in prayer (qibla).
topics.compliance: Highest respect. No depictions of prophets or sacred figures, no faces, no humour, no political content. Verify with diyanet.gov.tr / official Saudi sources. Flat 2D architecture only.

topics.title_tr: Kıble yönü nasıl hesaplanır? Koordinat sistemi
topics.hook: Japonya'dan kıble neden batıya değil, kuzeybatıya bakar?
facts_to_check: Qibla follows the great-circle (shortest path on a sphere), not a straight line on a flat map.
Latitude/longitude: Greenwich prime meridian adopted 1884 (International Meridian Conference).
Muslim astronomers (e.g. al-Biruni) computed qibla with spherical trigonometry.

topics.title_tr: 2.200 yıl önce Dünya'nın çevresi bir sopayla ölçüldü
topics.hook: Bir sopa ve bir kuyu… Dünya'nın çevresini ölçmeye yetti.
facts_to_check: Eratosthenes (~240 BCE) used shadows at Syene and Alexandria.
Angle ~7.2 degrees = 1/50 of a circle.
His result was close to the real ~40,000 km (accuracy depends on the stadion length - say so).

topics.title_tr: Dünyanın en küçük ülkesi bir şehrin içinde
topics.hook: Bir ülkeyi yürüyerek bir saatte turlayabilirsin.
facts_to_check: Vatican City ~0.44 km2, smallest independent state.
Independent since the Lateran Treaty 1929.
St Peter's Basilica dome designed by Michelangelo (completed after his death).
topics.compliance: respectful; no clergy scandals or politics.

topics.hook: Bu kubbe 1.500 yıldır depremlere direniyor.
facts_to_check: Built 532-537 in about five years under Justinian (Anthemius & Isidorus).
Dome ~31 m across, rebuilt after the 558 collapse; Mimar Sinan added buttresses in the 16th c.
Windows ring at the base makes the dome look like it floats.
topics.compliance: respect both its mosque and its history; no politics about its status.

topics.hook: İstanbul'un altında 336 sütunlu bir saray var.
facts_to_check: Built in the 6th century under Justinian.
336 columns (verify).
Two Medusa heads used as column bases, one upside down.

topics.hook: Denizin ortasındaki bu kulenin bir efsanesi var… ama gerçeği daha ilginç.
facts_to_check: Legend of the princess and the snake (label as legend).
Used as lighthouse, quarantine station, customs (verify).
Restored and reopened 2023 (verify).

topics.title_tr: Piri Reis haritası Antarktika'yı mı gösteriyor?
topics.hook: 1513'te çizilmiş bir harita Amerika'yı gösteriyor… bazıları Antarktika'yı da gördüğünü iddia ediyor.
facts_to_check: Drawn by Ottoman admiral Piri Reis in 1513, found in Topkapı Palace in 1929.
One of the oldest surviving maps showing the Americas; partly based on a lost Columbus map (Piri Reis's own notes).
Antarctica claim: historians say the southern coast is a bent South American coast - no evidence of Antarctica.
topics.compliance: iddia vs kanıt; Turkish pride angle ok.

topics.hook: 500 yıl önce bir Türk denizci, Akdeniz'in her koyunu tek kitapta çizdi.
facts_to_check: Piri Reis, Kitab-ı Bahriye (1521, revised 1526).
Over 200 maps/charts (verify number).
Gives harbours, currents, dangers.

topics.hook: Dünyanın en büyük çölü kum değil, buz.
facts_to_check: Antarctica is the largest desert (very low precipitation).
Holds ~70% of Earth's fresh water (verify).
Antarctic Treaty 1959: only peaceful science.

topics.hook: Kilometrelerce buzun altında, milyonlarca yıldır karanlıkta bir göl var.
facts_to_check: Lake Vostok ~4 km under the ice (verify).
One of the largest subglacial lakes.
Russian drill reached it in 2012.

topics.title_tr: Mu kıtası: Pasifik'te batan bir uygarlık mı?
topics.hook: Pasifik'in ortasında batmış bir kıta varmış… öyle mi?
facts_to_check: Idea popularised by James Churchward (1926) after Augustus Le Plongeon.
Plate tectonics and seafloor geology show no sunken continent in the Pacific.
Zealandia: a real mostly-submerged continent (geology, 2017) - the honest twist.

topics.hook: Atlantis'i ilk kez anlatan kişi bir tarihçi değil, bir filozoftu.
facts_to_check: Plato, Timaeus and Critias (~360 BCE).
Most historians see it as an allegory.
Thera (Santorini) eruption is often linked - say 'theory'.

topics.hook: Avrupa'nın korktuğu bir korsan, Osmanlı'nın büyük amirali oldu.
facts_to_check: Joined Ottoman service, Kapudan Pasha in 1533 (verify).
Battle of Preveza 1538.
Türbe in Beşiktaş.
topics.compliance: historical framing; no glorifying violence, no gore.

topics.title_tr: Karasakal'ın batan gemisi 280 yıl sonra bulundu
topics.hook: En ünlü korsanın gemisi 280 yıl sonra bulundu.
facts_to_check: Blackbeard = Edward Teach (or Thatch), died 1718.
Queen Anne's Revenge ran aground 1718 near Beaufort, NC; wreck found 1996.
Nassau as a pirate base (Republic of Pirates).
topics.compliance: no violence detail; no fictional film characters or film images (IP).

topics.title_tr: Dünyanın en günahkâr şehri denize gömüldü
topics.hook: Korsanların başkenti bir öğleden sonra denize battı.
facts_to_check: Port Royal, Jamaica - earthquake 7 June 1692.
About two-thirds of the town sank (verify).
Underwater archaeology site today.

topics.hook: Hazine haritası, göz bandı, tahtadan yürütme… çoğu filmden.
facts_to_check: Buried treasure was rare - Captain Kidd is the famous exception (Gardiners Island 1699).
Walking the plank: very few documented cases.
Eye patch theory (night vision) is unproven - say so.
topics.compliance: mention films generically only, no film names/characters/images (IP).

topics.hook: Karayipler'de bir kaplumbağa adası korsanların kalesi oldu.
facts_to_check: Tortuga (Île de la Tortue), Haiti; 17th c. buccaneer base.
Name means turtle (shape).
French/Spanish control changes.

topics.hook: Eski gemiciler enlemi bilirdi… ama boylamı bilemezdi.
facts_to_check: Latitude from the sun/Polaris angle.
Longitude needs exact time; John Harrison's marine chronometer H4 (1761 trial).
Longitude Act 1714 prize.

topics.hook: Pusula yok, harita yok… yine de binlerce kilometre okyanus geçtiler.
facts_to_check: Polynesian wayfinding: stars, swells, birds, clouds.
Hōkūleʻa voyage to Tahiti 1976 without instruments.
Settlement of remote islands like Hawaiʻi and Rapa Nui.

topics.title_tr: Atlantik'i yelkenliyle geçmek kaç gün sürerdi?
topics.hook: Atlantik'i yelkenle geçmek uçakla 8 saat… eskiden ise haftalar.
facts_to_check: Columbus 1492: Canary Islands to the Bahamas ~5 weeks (verify days).
Trade winds made the westward route possible.
Return used the westerlies further north (volta do mar).
topics.compliance: neutral historical framing (colonisation impact can be mentioned neutrally).

topics.hook: Dünyayı ilk dolaşan seferi başlatan kaptan, sonunu göremedi.

Proved the Earth could be circumnavigated.

topics.hook: Yılın en uzun gününde güneş, bu taşların arasından doğuyor.
